name: Hotel Garni Glocker
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Glocker is nestled in a quiet location in Tyrol's renowned Zillertal Valley. A warm family atmosphere and idyllic alpine meadows set the scene for a relaxing holiday. Scenic hiking trails are accessible directly from the property in summer, while popular ski areas are just a short drive away in winter. Facilities include a cosy breakfast room, a sauna, storage for sports equipment, and rooms with balconies overlooking the mountains.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Glocker in the Zillertal Valley offers a peaceful family-run bed-and-breakfast, featuring a sauna, balcony rooms, and easy access to trails and ski lifts.
